name: Grilled sticky-rice banana
summary: Chuối nếp nướng is a banana rolled in coconut sticky rice, wrapped in banana leaf, and grilled until the leaf chars and the rice crust turns yellow. It is crisp, hot, and fragrant, and best with coconut cream and roasted peanut.
origin: A Mekong snack, found in Châu Đốc and in many delta towns.
howToEat: Chuối sứ is rinsed in lightly salted water and rested with sugar and a little salt. Sticky rice cooked with coconut milk is spread thin around it, wrapped in banana leaf, and grilled.
It is ready when the leaf is charred and the rice crust is yellow and fragrant. Eat it with coconut cream and roasted peanut.
where: Snack grills in Châu Đốc and across the Mekong.
seoTitle: Chuoi nep nuong in Chau Doc
seoDescription: Chuối nếp nướng is banana in coconut sticky rice, grilled in banana leaf and served with coconut cream and peanut, in Châu Đốc and the Mekong.
